text:
maria: bringing up strix-11b (int4) on canary. throughput is ok for short prompts but long tails drop to ~35 t/s and we saw 2 OOMs when requests go >600 tokens. anyone seen this layout-specific frag?
cheng: saw one similar on a different canary — kernel_queue stalls then big kv cache growth. logs showed cudaMallocAsync OOMs.
ops-bot: ALERT: OOM detected on canary-node-12 at 2024-04-02T02:12:05Z (container strix-canary). restarted.
indra: checklist: (1) check prefix_prefetch behavior (int4 can fragment), (2) verify slot reservation vs max_new_tokens default, (3) batching shape spikes.
sam: can you pull the perf dump and a small gen trace? need median + p95 token latency and slot usage.
maria: quick metrics: median token latency 360ms -> 760ms during spike, throughput 92->36 t/s at 70% cpu. OOMs at gen length ~612. dash: https://internal/dash/strix11b (internal)
cheng: paste from logs: ```
[02:11:58] kv_cache_alloc: slots=238k target=250k
[02:12:01] kernel_queue: pending=14 stall=42ms
[02:12:05] cudaMallocAsync -> OOM
[02:12:05] runtime: evicting 140MB kv entries
```
indra: quick mitigations to try on canary: model.max_new_tokens_default=320, batch.max_batch_size=2, prefix_prefetch=off, slot_compactor=on with compact_threshold=0.2. also consider kv_prune_ratio=0.5.
maria: will apply config and run a small eval set before/after (10 QA + 5 summarization prompts).
ops-bot: DEPLOY STARTED: deploy/strix11b-canary-20240402-0215 by maria
(20m later)
maria: post-change summary: throughput recovered to ~80 t/s under same load, tail latency improved to 430ms, no OOMs in 25m. quality: EM 0.86 -> 0.854, PPL 19.0 -> 19.5. small drop but within product tolerance.
sam: agree to expand canary to 10% traffic. add trace_rate=0.2 for 30m and run regression harness periodically.
cheng: follow-ups: (1) add a fragmentation smoke test into onboarding (long tails + mixed batch shapes), (2) set per-model conservative max_new_tokens defaults for int4 quantized models, (3) record kernel stall metrics in model profile.
indra: i'll add the smoke script to the onboarding harness and a one-line check that flags slot variance > 0.12.
maria: opened ticket RED-784 to track rollout and follow-ups. closing thread unless regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
